title: Keto Low-Carb Shirataki Noodles Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy keto stir fry made with shirataki noodles, unctuous chicken, and a dash of mexican spices.
instructions: Cook the shirataki noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through.
Add the mexican unctuous sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked shirataki noodles to the skillet and stir to combine.
Squeeze the lime juice over the top of the noodles and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Sprinkle the chopped cilantro over the top of the noodles and serve.
